name: weekly-digest
description: /digest [days] writes a plain-English digest of what shipped across the repos your sessions touched: merged PRs and pushed commits, work in flight, decisions waiting on you, and time and usage per repo. Saved as markdown and shown in a pane; never sent anywhere unless you turn on polish.

digestDir.title: Digest folder
digestDir.description: Where /digest saves digest-<date>.md. ~ or a relative path starts at your home folder.

extraRepos.title: Extra repos
extraRepos.description: More repo folders to include, separated by commas or semicolons, even if no session ran in them.

authorEmails.title: Your commit emails
authorEmails.description: Your commit author emails (comma separated), matched exactly. Empty: the repo's git user.email.

polish.title: Polished update
polish.description: Also ask a small model (haiku) to turn the digest into a 10-line team or investor update, shown under it. On: folder paths, commit and PR titles and open decisions go to that model. Off: no model call, nothing sent.
